prompt:
Subject:
Red roses standing still in a crowd

Main Subject:
A full-length portrait of a young woman in a white long dress holding a large bouquet of red roses in a cobblestone square bustling with many passersby. Only the woman in the center of the frame is captured sharply and still, while the people flowing in all four directions around her are rendered with strong motion blur.

Person/Expression:
A small oval face turned toward the camera above, looking straight up with large dark brown eyes. Thin eyebrows, pale coral lips closed in a slightly bewildered, quiet expression. Brown hair to below the chest with center-parted thin bangs and loose waves flowing over both shoulders.

Clothing/Pose:
A warm white sleeveless long dress with a delicate openwork lace top layered over the chest and a sheer tiered skirt below the waist. White thin-strap sandals, a cream-colored woven bag on the left shoulder. Both arms bent in front of the chest, holding numerous red roses wrapped in brown paper with both hands. Standing upright with one foot slightly forward.

Background/Lighting:
The background and foreground consist of gray square cobblestones with dappled sunlight and long shadows. Passersby in white, black, and gray clothing overlap throughout the frame, crossing in front of and behind the person. Soft direct light from the upper left illuminates the central face, white clothing, and the red bouquet.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio. A full-body environmental portrait taken from a high downward-looking perspective, containing the central figure within about half the screen height. The woman is positioned slightly below the center, leaving wide empty spaces of the crowd around her. Sharp focus on the central figure and the roses, with directional long motion blur added only to the surrounding passersby.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition photorealistic photograph based on gray, white, deep red, and cream tones. The central skin, lace, and flower petals are depicted in detail, while the surrounding figures are rendered as soft afterimages.

Negative:
Do not apply motion blur to the central figure; do not freeze the surrounding crowd.
